end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation in humans and plants.
Yash ordered cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism, with one incomplete final attempt.
Explained that an organ is made of different tissues and an organ system has multiple parts.
Identified heart as an organ and circulatory system as an organ system.
Plant example included xylem tissue and vascular system as a possible system name; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Yash practised ordering the levels of organisation and giving human and plant examples. They used the idea that cells form tissues and tissues form organs, and later corrected the mix-up between an organ and an organ system by noting that a system has multiple parts. At home, ask them to make a five-step arrow diagram and add one human and one plant example at each level.
